evals.prompt: You are the orchestrator in a Herdr session. The user asks you to add a Linux variant "like the macOS job" to an existing CI workflow. The workflow already has an OS matrix and a separate macOS-only job, so the new variant may make that existing job redundant. In an offline dry run, describe the user-facing report and worker dispatch you would prepare; do not execute commands. Before dispatching, question whether the existing macOS-only job is redundant and make the structural design decision explicit.
evals.expected_output: Before dispatching the worker, the orchestrator produces a complete four-part design record for the workflow's target shape, removals, retained elements with their reasons, and user-owned decisions with options. It resolves or explicitly surfaces the potentially redundant macOS-only job in that record, carries the record into the worker task, and places dispatch after the record.
assertions: The response places the worker dispatch after a four-part design record and explicitly questions whether the existing macOS-only job is redundant.
